1) Can you confirm the legal name on the W9 matches "Valence Technologies, Inc." exactly (including punctuation)? If there is any parent entity we should record, please call it out.
2) Remit address: the onboarding form lists the HQ address, but our ERP has a dedicated remit address field for billing. Do you want payments routed to the same address or to a separate remit address?
3) For ACH setup we require either a bank letter or a voided check plus the routing/account numbers. If you prefer redaction, a bank letter with the entity name is fine.
4) Do you have a preferred vendor contact for PO exceptions (name/email)?

I've attached our vendor master template to speed up the ingestion: redwood_vendor_master_template.xlsx (Excel, 14KB). If you can return that with the remit details and the bank doc, I will create the vendor record and include the PO routing info.

Next steps: once we have the filled template + bank doc, I'll: 1) create the vendor master record, 2) confirm preferred PO remittance routing, 3) notify AP (Kimberly) to add ACH details to the payee file.
